description.text: Starter Set VSTAR Lucario, a 60-card deck released on 25 February 2022 with Darkrai's, built around the new Lucario VSTAR and its Lucario V. Lucario VSTAR's VSTAR Power deals 70 damage for each Energy attached to the opponent's Pokémon in play, and Gutsy Pickaxe and Double Turbo Energy help power it up. Both decks hold Crobat V, Quick Ball, Ultra Ball, Cynthia's Ambition, Professor's Research and Boss's Orders, and each came with a VSTAR marker, a playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers and a player's guide.
